snippets.text: Pulmonary lymphoma refers to lung parenchymal involvement with lymphoma and can be categorized as primary or secondary. Primary pulmonary lymphoma is rare and is usually non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma. It is limited to the lung and there is no evidence of extrathoracic involvement for at least 3 mo after the diagnosis. Secondary pulmonary lymphoma, on the other hand, is relatively common and can be Hodgkin’s lymphoma or non-Hodgkin’s lymphoma.
